newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador foreign reserves rise to $1.83 bln end '96.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador foreign reserves rise to $1.83 bln end '96.

text.p: Ecuador's foreign reserves were $1.83 billion at the end of 1996, up $275 million from $1.56 billion at the end of the 1995, a Central Bank spokesman said Monday.
Reserves rose by $180 million, or 10.9 percent, in December.
"Making an assessment of 1996, one observes that higher international oil prices have contributed to this significant increase in reserves," the spokesman told Reuters.
Current reserves beat the previous record of $1.77 billion in June 1995.
